# Command-line reference

The help of the `tlilli` command and each of its subcommands. Exit codes: 0 success, 1 user error, 2 internal error (`FR-01-050`).

## `tlilli`

```text
The tlilli command: export, import, skills install, mcp proxy, doctor and schema generators

Usage: tlilli [OPTIONS]
       tlilli <COMMAND>

Commands:
  mcp     Describe the MCP server's protocol surface
  schema  Generate the committed JSON Schemas
  skills  Build the skill pack from its sources
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --help-markdown
          Print the command reference as Markdown (docs/reference/cli.md) and exit

  -h, --help
          Print help

  -V, --version
          Print version
```

## `tlilli mcp`

```text
Describe the MCP server's protocol surface

Usage: tlilli mcp <COMMAND>

Commands:
  schema  Write the MCP protocol reference: tools.md, resources.md and prompts.md
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `tlilli mcp schema`

```text
Write the MCP protocol reference: tools.md, resources.md and prompts.md

Usage: tlilli mcp schema --markdown <DIR>

Options:
      --markdown <DIR>
          Directory to write the pages into (docs/reference/mcp in the repository)

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
